subject: CloudLane + GSI: Marketplace integration discovery & demo scheduling
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@cloudlane.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Bellini <marco.b@gsi-partners.com>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-03T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — CloudLane x Redwood marketplace fit (follow-up & next steps)

Hi Aditya — great to meet everyone on the call earlier. Quick recap from CloudLane's side and suggested next steps:

- Key ask: validate the Redwood marketplace onboarding flow and confirm integration points (deployable AMI / container, listing metadata, entitlement checks).
- Stakeholders to include: CloudLane product lead (me), GSI technical architect (Marco), and our marketplace ops.
- We'd like a joint technical deep-dive / demo with Redwood SEs to cover: listing process, private deployment options (VPC & on-prem), and licensing/entitlement hooks.

Availability (our team):
- Tue 10/05 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 10/06 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu 10/07 15:00–16:00 PT

I've attached a short discovery notes PDF (CloudLane-Discovery-Notes.pdf) that includes our current marketplace checklist and priority integrations. Can you confirm which slot works for Redwood and who will attend from your side?

Thanks — happy to be flexible on time zones.

—Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships | CloudLane Solutions
pri...@cloudlane.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: CloudLane-Discovery-Notes.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudlane.com>, Marco Bellini <marco.b@gsi-partners.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-03T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — CloudLane x Redwood marketplace fit (follow-up & next steps)

Priya — thanks for the clear recap and the attached notes, very helpful. We're excited to run the joint technical deep-dive. Quick answers and proposed plan:

- Redwood attendees: myself (AM, partnerships), Vanessa Ortiz (Marketplace Lead), and a Redwood SE (TBD) — I'll loop SE once time is confirmed.
- Suggested agenda (30–45m): 1) 10 min goals & architecture, 2) 15 min demo of marketplace listing + entitlement flow, 3) 10 min integration Q&A, 4) next steps & milestones. Happy to extend for more technical deep-dive.

From the slots you shared, we can do:
- Wed 10/06 09:00–09:45 PT — best for Vanessa + SE availability
- Tue 10/05 11:00–11:45 PT — backup option

I've included a Calendly link to pick the confirmed slot if that helps: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-se-demo-30m

For the SE prep: can you add a short list of integration priorities (entitlement, private deploy, support matrix) to the shared Drive folder? I linked our onboarding checklist and will attach it here for quick alignment (redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx).

Looping in Sergio (alliances) and Vanessa (marketplace) to own the meeting logistics and technical alignment.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0112

> From the slots you shared, we can do:
> - Wed 10/06 09:00–09:45 PT — best for Vanessa + SE availability

Thanks — Wed 10/06 09:00 PT works for GSI team (I'll join as technical architect). Two quick asks from our side before the call:

1) Pre-call agenda: could you add 2–3 concrete integration scenarios we should validate (e.g., entitlement via marketplace tokens, automated image sync, customer IAM mapping)? That will let our engineers prepare.
2) Confirmation on private deployment options: does Redwood support a VPC-only private deployment that still connects to marketplace entitlement APIs (no egress to public internet)? We need to know before the deep dive.

If you prefer, we can push to Thu 10/07 15:00 PT but we'd rather keep Wed if Redwood can confirm the SE.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marco Bellini
Principal Architect | GSI Partners Inc.
marco.b@gsi-partners.com
